summary.text: Matthew Albion is the Republican candidate for the New Hampshire House of Representatives, Strafford 17, in the November 3, 2026 general election, where he faces incumbent Democrat Jessica LaMontagne.
Albion also ran for the seat in 2024.

paragraphs.text: Matthew Albion was the Republican candidate for Strafford 17 in 2024, losing the November 5, 2024 general election to incumbent Jessica LaMontagne, 1,739 votes (63.9%) to 983 (36.1%).
